properties.name: The loop nudge covers the session that never touches the graph
properties.statement: A session that edits code while making zero reflow2 calls must receive the same one-time Stop nudge as one that writes the graph unchecked: the nudge arms on the harness's file-edit events (Edit/Write), not only on reflow2 write events. Today loop_nudge.py counts only mcp__reflow2__ writes, so the total-bypass session — the agent that ignores the design brain entirely — passes the Stop hook silently. Constraints carried over: the hook never reads the graph (single-writer lock), blocks once and never twice, and names what is owed (loop_status; impact-check before further edits, link-artifacts after) rather than demanding a ritual call; an edit-count threshold bounds false positives on typo/docs sessions. (BL-90, BL-74 family.)
